notes.title: Preset System Improvements & Offset Customization
notes.content: [h2]Preset System Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Added community preset editing - users can now edit the name, description, tags, and games of the presets they shared.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a reset option to local presets. This resets each setting saved in the given preset.[/p][/*][*][p]Author name is now highlighted if the community preset was made by the user.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved multi-line handling in community preset descriptions.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Offset customization[/h2][list][*][p]Specify an additional offset for each axis in the mapping settings.[/p][/*][*][p]This offsets the centered position by the specified value.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Other small changes[/h2][list][*][p]Add credit to the opentrack software in the about tab.[/p][/*][*][p]Make error messages more specific.[/p][/*][*][p]Log movement and angular speed in the status info panel (top right circle).[/p][/*][*][p]Log jitter values in the status panel.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fix centering displaying a save as dialog for community presets.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix a camera backend bug on Windows.[/p][/*][*][p]Block keybind detection when typing in a text field.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix a bug where keybinds sometimes do not work.[/p][/*][*][p]Verify that no special characters are used when saving a preset locally.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Community Presets: Now Live for Everyone
notes.content: [h2]Community Presets[/h2][list][*][p]Browse and share community presets in the [b]Presets window.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309925/745cbfaf765473d8982fa5c0076c89f15122c676.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]You can toggle community presets by pressing the [b]community toggle [/b]next to the search bar.[/p][/*][*][p]To share a preset, click the [b]options button[/b] (three dots) next to your preset and click the [b]Share[/b] [b]button[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Each community preset has the following additional attributes: [/p][olist][*][p][b]Author[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Description[/b] (optional) - describe where your preset works the best and what it is meant for.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tags[/b] (optional) - assign any tags to your presets so that users can find them more easily.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Games[/b] (optional) - select the game/s where your preset works best.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p]To add a community preset to your favorites, click the [b]heart [/b]icon next to the preset.[/p][/*][*][p]You can [b]search[/b] community presets by typing their [b]name[/b] or [b]games[/b] they support into the [b]search bar[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]To [b]save[/b] a community preset [b]locally[/b], press the [b]options button [/b](three dots) next to the community preset and press the [b]Save as[/b] button. This will allow you to customize the preset to your liking and optionally share it again.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed camera support issues for certain camera types.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed VDF error on app startup.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed quick guide dialog scaling issues.[/p][/*][*][p]X/Y/Z position changes are now also affected by deadzone setting.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed float error in mapping customization.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Steam runtime detection issue.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Other small changes[/h2][list][*][p]Added share and keybind options to default preset.[/p][/*][*][p]Lower default rotation sensitivities to 1:1 (real:mapped) for every axis.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 5:4 resolutions to camera settings.  [/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Mapping Update & UX Improvements
notes.content: [h2]Mapping changes[/h2][list][*][p]Added maximum input and output customization to mapping settings allowing for more precise control.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified defaults for mapping sensitivity of all rotating movement to be twice the real rotation.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified default maximum input and output for all axes (head rotation output: [b]360 -> 180[/b], head position input, output: [b]300 -> 100[/b], eye rotation input: [b]90 -> 45[/b], eye rotation output: [b]360 -> 180[/b]).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Changed defaults[/h2][list][*][p]Doubled default sensitivity for [b]head rotation[/b] and [b]eye rotation[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased default [i]FPS[/i] from [b]20[/b] to [b]30[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Better error handling[/h2][list][*][p]Improved error / issue detection in [b]freetrack (Wine)[/b] protocol.[/p][/*][*][p]The app now detects when it's launched via [b]Proton[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to everyone for the feedback![/p]

notes.content:

notes.title: LookPilot Official Release
notes.content:
[p]Today we’re launching [b]LookPilot 1.0[/b] — webcam-based [b]6DoF head & eye tracking[/b] for PC games. Blend head rotation with eye movement to your preference and the game camera follows, making flight, racing, trucking, space and FPS titles feel more natural — with no extra hardware.[/p][p][/p][p]Setup is simple: install, start tracking, launch your game. Most supported games recognize LookPilot automatically; some require enabling head-tracking once in the game’s settings. LookPilot runs with [b]low CPU usage[/b], works even with lower-quality webcams, and supports both Windows and Linux (including titles launched via Wine).[/p][p]
[b]Free to try:[/b] Download the [b]Demo[/b] to start a [b]7-day trial.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Highlights[/h2][list][*][p]Webcam-based [b]6DoF[/b] head & eye tracking (no extra hardware)[/p][/*][*][p]Works with [b]700+[/b] games via standard head-tracking interfaces[/p][/*][*][p]Windows & Linux support, including titles launched through Wine[/p][/*][*][p]Quick setup: Install → Start tracking → Launch your game[/p][/*][*][p]Customizable mapping, smoothing, deadzones; per-axis control[/p][/*][*][p]Keybinds for recenter, toggle tracking, and preset switching[/p][/*][*][p]High-rate output with low CPU usage[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Popular Games[/h2][list][*][p][i]DCS World, Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020/2024, IL-2, X-Plane 12[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Euro Truck Simulator 2, American Truck Simulator[/p][/*][*][p][i]Assetto Corsa / Competizione, iRacing, Automobilista 2[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Elite Dangerous, Star Citizen[/p][/*][*][p]Arma 3, Insurgency: Sandstorm[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Tell Us What to Improve[/h2][p]Share feedback and presets in the Steam Discussions — your input guides what we build next.[/p][p][/p][p]Try the free demo now![/p]

notes.title: LookPilot – Major Update (Pre-Release)
notes.content:
[h2]Interface Update[/h2][list]  [*]Renamed app to [b]LookPilot[/b] (previously Clearsight).[/*]  [*]Completely redesigned the [b]GUI[/b] to be more modern, intuitive, and streamlined.[/*]  [*]Removed dependency on [b]Opentrack[/b]. Tracking now starts directly within LookPilot.[/*]  [*]Implemented customizable [b]keybindings[/b] for toggling and centering tracking.[/*]  [*]Added new [b]language support[/b]: Arabic, Czech, German, Spanish, French, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian, Turkish, Ukrainian, Simplified Chinese.[/*]  [*]New [b]Feedback Tab[/b]: Submit suggestions and bug reports directly from the app. Your feedback is greatly appreciated![/*][/list][h2]Tracking Update[/h2][list]  [*]Significantly improved accuracy and stability of [b]head and eye tracking models[/b].[/*]  [*]Added advanced [b]performance settings[/b]:    [list]      [*]Adjustable tracking FPS limit.[/*]      [*]GPU acceleration (optional).[/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]New [b]presets system[/b]: create, save, and switch between tracking configurations.[/*]  [*]Expanded [b]tracking customization[/b] options:    [list]      [*]Separate smoothness sliders for head and eye tracking.[/*]      [*]Axis-specific rotation and position mapping.[/*]      [*]Adjustable eye tracking influence on overall control.[/*]    [/list]  [/*][/list]
[b]Thanks for your continued support—enjoy LookPilot![/b]
Special thanks to [u]CoolyGoon[/u] for valuable feedback and Discord server improvements.

notes.title: Clearsight Update - Beta 0.2.0
notes.content:
[h2]UI Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Renamed [b]Opentrack[/b] tab to [b]Gaming[/b].
[*] Renamed [b]Head Tracking Ratio[/b] to [b]Eye Tracking Influence[/b].
[*] Merged [b]Calibration[/b] and [b]Overlay[/b] tabs into [b]Gaze Estimation[/b].
[*] Added labels to settings sections for clarity.
[*] Introduced a new [b]Privacy[/b] tab.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309925/8a9eac79e0722bd4760de14aeeb6f147a74bc60b.png[/img]

[h2]Screen Selection[/h2]
Added an option to select the screen for gaze estimation.
This determines on which screen the calibration will be performed and where the overlay will be displayed.

[h2]Voluntary Data Collection[/h2]
You can now help improve Clearsight by enabling [b]anonymous data collection[/b].  
To participate, go to the [b]Privacy[/b] tab and enable the [b]Send Anonymous Gaze Data[/b] option.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309925/1e33079586ef47cd4766c47d888e5881ad0a145a.png[/img]

Your privacy is important—there is no way to identify you from the data collected. Only pupil locations, eye landmark locations, and head rotation are sent.  

When enabled, Clearsight automatically sends extracted features to the database after each calibration. This data helps improve the software for all users.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed infinite loading of the calibration window if no head was detected.
[*] Added checks for head and eye presence during calibration.
[/list]
